launch_go: Separate current CASE/environment/runtime preflight and launch seal remain required before the authorized single fresh sphere.

findings.assessment: Single path.lstat snapshot returns type/reparse attributes/size; no resolve on mutable leaf and no target content open. Reparse flag0x400 and S_ISLNK refuse before counting, including observed LX_SYMLINK. Nonregular unexpected object refuses. Vanished entries skip; unexpected permission/IO propagates.

Root/each traversed directory gets no-follow metadata, existing strict checked ancestry and exact device/inode identity. Directory metadata is checked again at end and identity must remain; observed replacement/redirect refuses. If checked raises CompactPathRedirect, only a fresh metadata FileNotFound escapes as vanished; a present redirect/reparse/unexpected IO still refuses. Removed directory returns observed total conservatively; snapshot is not an atomic full-tree inventory.

No new deny-write/delete handles or content reads in the counter, so it does not pin directories against legitimate cleanup. Real directory removal overlaps monitor scans in focused test without removal errors.

All compact_lifecycle class/top-level function ASTs other than live_bytes are identical to prior tested candidate. Copy/export/finalizer/receipt/source/worker/native helper/mesher/offline code bytes are unchanged. Strict path checks in publication, source guards, receipt authorization and same-handle deletion remain independent. compact_paths.checked only adds comparison-time requested/resolved/state diagnostics; true redirects/reparse are not granted acceptance.

No numerical operations, geometry/source predicates, optimizer policies, thresholds, source proof payloads or mesh acceptance paths change. Counter handles logical metadata only; its observations cannot issue source/live/publication/deletion authority.

closed_V2.population: 8 new monitor tests plus34 existing compact lifecycle/storage controls

meaningful_controls: Real concurrent checkpoint create/replace/unlink, >100 writer/sampler operations, no writer errors
Concurrent real nested directory cleanup overlaps scans with no locks blocking removal
Exact static recursive bytes/case forms and strict traversal boundary
Actual outside junction refuses both root/nested; target unchanged
Actual file symlink or unprivileged DrvFs LX_SYMLINK fallback refused by reparse attributes
Persistent IO and stable mocked directory redirect not ignored
Real payload exceeding output quota refuses
Inherited recursive native payload/root bindings, atomic publication, receipt, active/reparse/partial cleanup controls remain in34 passing component tests
test_evidence.limitations: Focused Windows operational fixtures, not formal arbitrary-adversary race freedom or a new complete mesh/lifecycle qualification. V1 skip history remains preserved; V2 real reparse fallback closes that coverage gap.

known_limits: A transient ancestor reparse swap can expose metadata before the before/after checks detect a stable change; the code explicitly discloses this preexisting path-based observation limit. No outside file contents, proofs or authorization are accepted by this metadata counter. Static/observed reparse fixtures are refused.
The counter remains sampled logical-size observation, not physical allocation, aggregate Linux RSS or exact atomic whole-run peak. New files can appear between samples, as before.
Unknown/unsupported races may still conservatively refuse. This does not prove PERF21 specific offending path, which was not recorded.
An actual new sphere run is still required to qualify the live changed lifecycle under separately reviewed input/environment gates. First actual failure stops; no retry or other case implicit.
scope: Read-only source/Git/AST/text/hash and existing closed log inspection only. No project imports, tests/fixtures, geometry/native/scientific execution, mesh/comparer/census, source edits or cleanup by reviewer.
